question: Please provide the top 10 tree species in New York, using their uppercase Latin names where the Latin name is not empty and including their common names, showing the total number of trees, the counts of alive and dead trees for each year, and the corresponding growth in these counts from 1995 to 2015, then order by the difference in total tree counts between these years.
sql:
WITH y1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
y2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common
),
y2015_common AS (
  SELECT latin_name, spc_common, total_count, alive_count, dead_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin_name ORDER BY total_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM y2015
),
y2015_final AS (
  SELECT latin_name, spc_common AS common_name, total_count, alive_count, dead_count
  FROM y2015_common
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  y1995.latin_name,
  y2015_final.common_name,
  y1995.total_count AS total_1995,
  y2015_final.total_count AS total_2015,
  y1995.alive_count AS alive_1995,
  y2015_final.alive_count AS alive_2015,
  y1995.dead_count AS dead_1995,
  y2015_final.dead_count AS dead_2015,
  y2015_final.total_count - y1995.total_count AS total_growth,
  y2015_final.alive_count - y1995.alive_count AS alive_growth,
  y2015_final.dead_count - y1995.dead_count AS dead_growth
FROM y1995
INNER JOIN y2015_final ON y1995.latin_name = y2015_final.latin_name
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10
